note: Rules for scripts/services/place-files.mjs, the service that puts files from a bundle into the right folders and commits them. This file is itself protected: a bundle can never change it, so a bundle cannot loosen its own checks. Edit it by hand. Every list here is PROVISIONAL (Claude's starting guess).
_allowed: A bundle may write under scripts/ and docs/, and top-level .md files (design docs, changelog). Nothing else.
_denied: .github/ is denied twice over: the automatic GitHub token cannot push workflow files anyway, and a workflow is code that runs with write access. Add workflows by hand. ledger/ and sources/ are written only by their own services.
_protected: Files the app or Tom edits live. A stale copy in a bundle must never overwrite them. Config files you edit (such as scripts/category-rules.json) can be sent with mode create-only, which skips the file if it already exists. scripts/services/place-files.mjs is the gatekeeper itself, so it is protected too: update it by hand.
_tests: Test files in the bundle (scripts/tests/*.test.mjs) are run after the files are written. If any fail, every file is put back as it was and nothing is committed.
